description: Stryker Corporation is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better, offering innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology and Orthopaedics that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes, and alongside its customers around the world it impacts more than 150 million patients annually. Stryker was incorporated in Michigan in 1946 as the successor company to a business founded in 1941 by Dr. Homer H. Stryker, a prominent orthopaedic surgeon and inventor of several medical products, and its products, sold in approximately 61 countries, include platform technology, products for traditional brain and open skull-based surgical procedures, minimally invasive products for the treatment of acute ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke and venous thromboembolism, implants used in joint replacement and trauma surgeries, Mako robotic-arm assisted technology, and other products used in a variety of medical specialties, with most of its products marketed directly to doctors, hospitals and other healthcare facilities.
